thread:
morgan: Quick postmortem follow-up: we saw delayed partition commits that allowed replayed batches to write twice, causing small token inflation across ~0.9% of invoices. Need clear owners for audit CSV, credits, consumer guardrails, and recurrence detection.

kai: I'll take detection + RC doc. Plan: emit partition_commit_lag gauge, add an idempotency header at ingest, and backfill-deduper. ETA Tue 2026-05-20.

asha: I can own credits & customer comms. Proposal: auto-credit <$35, flag >$300 for manual review. Drafting CSV template + sample email. ETA Mon EOD (2026-05-18).

franz-eng: I'll patch the consumer to skip records with duplicate_batch_id and add a staging dry-run. Will add unit tests simulating partition reassign + replay. ETA Mon 2026-05-18 morning.

ellie-fin: Finance needs CSV columns: invoice_id, account_id, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, credit_usd, reason_code. @asha attach when ready, will validate and sign-off.

billing-bot: Ticket MET-7120 created: "Partition commit lag -> replayed batches: audit & credits" assignees: kai,asha,franz-eng due: 2026-05-27

kai: useful starter query to find suspects (tweak window as needed):

```
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, SUM(token_count) AS tokens, COUNT(*) AS rows, MAX(batch_id) AS batch_id
FROM usage_ledger
WHERE source = 'metering-consumer' AND inserted_at >= '2026-05-10'
GROUP BY account_id, invoice_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 OR SUM(token_count) > 50000
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 300;
```

morgan: Action recap:
- kai: detection + RC doc + metric (ETA 2026-05-20)
- franz-eng: consumer dedupe patch + staging dry-run (ETA 2026-05-18)
- asha: credits CSV + template (ETA 2026-05-18 EOD)
- ellie-fin: validate CSV & sign-off (ETA 2026-05-19)

Please ack and add links to MET-7120 when you start. Keep customer-facing comms centralized with @ellie-fin to avoid duplicate outreach.

franz-eng: ack  starting patch branch now.

kai: ack  will add dashboard and an alert if partition_commit_lag > 60s for 5m.

asha: ack  will upload draft CSV to MET-7120 in 2h.

ellie-fin: ack  will run validation and flag credits > $500.

ops-bot: Reminder: MET-7120 remediation sync Fri 09:00 calendar invite sent.

morgan: thanks team. please include any recurring-pattern indicators (partition reassigns, consumer restarts, backlog spikes) in the RC doc so we can correlate with past incidents. :memo:
